During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Ailon Nova Guard/Legends|Ailon Nova Guard]] led an '''attack''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cona/Legends|Cona]].<ref name="GaW" />

==History==
During the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]],<ref name="GaW" /> between [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] and [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Ailon (species)/Legends|people]] of [[Ailon/Legends|Ailon]], awed by the military might of the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] invaders, switched its allegiance from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]].<ref name="GaW" />

The [[Ailon Nova Guard/Legends|Ailon Nova Guard]] then aided the invaders in their conquest of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], where they led [[Yuuzhan Vong]] vanguards against weak points in the defenses of [[Cona/Legends|Cona]], [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] and [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]].<ref name="GaW" />

Following the end of the war,<ref name="GaW" /> in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the planet Ailon suffered crippling economic sanctions due to the Ailon Nova Guard's support of the Yuuzhan Vong.<ref name="GaW" />
